title: Zero-Trust Architecture & Mutual TLS
content: Zero-Trust architecture enforces 'never trust, always verify'. Every microservice-to-microservice request must authenticate using Mutual TLS (mTLS) with short-lived cryptographically signed tokens. Secrets must never be stored in code or environment files directly, but accessed at runtime via Secret Manager with IAM role bindings.

title: Data Protection with AES-256-GCM & Envelope Encryption
content: All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM), providing both confidentiality and integrity verification. Cloud KMS Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) enable envelope encryption where data encryption keys (DEKs) are generated locally and encrypted with a master key stored in an HSM.

title: SOC 2 Type II & Continuous Audit Logging
content: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria require comprehensive non-repudiation audit logging for all privileged user actions, automated agent decisions, data modifications, and API invocations. Cloud Audit Logs and Cloud Logging provide tamper-evident storage with configurable log retention, BigQuery log analysis, and automated alerting on anomalous access.
